g.text: A builder focused on understanding systems before optimizing them.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Inter', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Computer Engineering undergraduate at Savitribai Phule Pune University (SPPU), graduating Class of 2027.
I design and engineer backend architectures with Python, structuring robust REST APIs, SQL schemas, and data pipelines.
My algorithmic foundation is built in Java, maintaining rigorous practice across ~120+ verified data structures & algorithms.
Currently targeting Software Development Engineer (SDE) and Python backend engineering opportunities in Pune and Bangalore.
